answer.answer: Ujjwala 2.0 introduced a special facility for migrant households, with an additional allocation of 1.6 Crore LPG connections [E03]. The predecessor programme (original PMUY launched in May 2016) established a transition to clean cooking fuel like LPG among rural and deprived families who traditionally relied on firewood, coal, or cow-dung cakes, helping reduce health risks for women and minimize environmental pollution [E03].

claim_to_evidence.claim: Ujjwala 2.0 has a special facility for migrant households with additional allocation of 1.6 Crore LPG connections
The predecessor PMUY programme promoted transition to clean cooking fuel like LPG among rural and deprived families who traditionally relied on firewood, coal, or cow-dung cakes
This shift helps reduce health risks for women and minimizes environmental pollution
